description: Fully fleshed out moral choice chains and merge quest.

quests.trigger: An eerie silence falls over the shelter before the perimeter alarms trigger.
quests.discovery: A shadowy figure emerges from the dust storms, flanked by armed mercenaries. It's a face you recognize—a survivor you either saved, abandoned, or exploited months ago.

choices.label: Welcome them with open arms, offering sanctuary regardless of past grievances.
choices.outcome_text: They lower their weapons. Forgiveness is a rare currency here, but it just bought you a loyal army.
choices.epitaph: Believed in redemption, even at the end of the world.

choices.label: Negotiate a cautious alliance, offering supplies for their protection.
choices.outcome_text: A tense handshake seals the deal. They will fight for you, but only as long as the rations flow.
choices.epitaph: Surviving meant trusting the math, not the man.

choices.label: Refuse entry, commanding your guards to shoot if they take another step.
choices.outcome_text: They retreat into the storm, but not before swearing a blood oath to return. You are safe—for tonight.
choices.epitaph: Built high walls, but left no room for humanity.

choices.label: Ambush them during parley. Strip their gear and hang the leader as a warning.
choices.outcome_text: The slaughter is swift and brutal. The bleeding bodies serve as a grim deterrent to any future ghosts.
choices.epitaph: Became the very monster the wasteland feared.

quests.trigger: You notice discrepancies in the armory logs.
quests.discovery: Late at night, you find a hidden stash of missing ammunition and a coded ledger. It belongs to Elias, your most trusted lieutenant.

choices.label: Confront Elias privately, giving him a chance to explain or return the supplies.
choices.outcome_text: He breaks down, admitting his family was taken hostage. He needed the ammo for a ransom.
choices.epitaph: Chose compassion when paranoia would have been easier.

choices.label: Confiscate the stash quietly and increase guard patrols without naming names.
choices.outcome_text: The supplies are secure, but Elias remains a wild card in your ranks.
choices.epitaph: Kept the peace by ignoring the war.

choices.label: Expose him publicly, stripping him of his rank and rations.
choices.outcome_text: Elias is humiliated and broken. The camp is safer, but morale takes a chilling dive.
choices.epitaph: Valued discipline over loyalty.

choices.label: Replace the stolen ammo with defective rounds to kill whoever he's supplying.
choices.outcome_text: Days later, Elias is found dead with a shattered rifle in his hands. You smile.
choices.epitaph: Punished treachery with ruthless ingenuity.

quests.trigger: A scout returns bleeding, muttering Elias's name.
quests.discovery: Elias didn't act alone. He was feeding intel to a raider syndicate planning to hit your water purifier.

choices.label: Heal the scout and send a peace envoy to the syndicate to buy them off.
choices.outcome_text: It costs dearly, but bloodshed is avoided. For now, the purifier is safe.
choices.epitaph: Believed peace was worth any price.

choices.label: Fortify the purifier and wait for their attack, minimizing civilian risk.
choices.outcome_text: The raiders break against your defenses. It's a pragmatic victory with minimal losses.
choices.epitaph: A steady shield in a broken world.

choices.label: Pre-emptively strike the syndicate's camp, burning their tents and supplies.
choices.outcome_text: You leave their camp in ashes. The message is clear: do not cross you.
choices.epitaph: Struck first, asked questions never.

choices.label: Capture Elias's co-conspirators in camp and torture them for the syndicate's weaknesses.
choices.outcome_text: Their screams echo through the night. The intelligence gained is flawless, but the camp fears you.
choices.epitaph: Extracted the truth through blood and bone.

quests.trigger: Elias is captured trying to slip out of the camp.
quests.discovery: He kneels in the dirt before you. He claims he did it to save his dying daughter, held by the raiders.

choices.label: Pardon him and offer a squad to help rescue his daughter.
choices.outcome_text: He weeps in gratitude. The rescue is successful, forging an unbreakable bond.
choices.epitaph: Proved that mercy is the ultimate strength.

choices.label: Exile him. He can try to save her alone, but he is dead to this camp.
choices.outcome_text: He walks into the wasteland alone. You never see him again.
choices.epitaph: Dispensed justice without malice.

choices.label: Execute him cleanly for treason. The law must be absolute.
choices.outcome_text: A single shot rings out. Order is maintained, though the silence that follows is heavy.
choices.epitaph: The law was iron, and so was your heart.

choices.label: Force him to fight a captured raider to the death for his life. Sell tickets.
choices.outcome_text: The camp howls for blood. Elias dies in the pit, and you profit from his despair.
choices.epitaph: Turned tragedy into entertainment.

quests.trigger: A sickness spreads through the lower decks of the shelter.
quests.discovery: The infirmary is out of medicine. You have just enough antibiotics to cure five people, but twenty are infected.

choices.label: Divide the doses equally among all twenty, hoping their immune systems pull through.
choices.outcome_text: It's a gamble, but most survive. The collective hope strengthens the community.
choices.epitaph: Refused to play god with human lives.

choices.label: Give the antibiotics to the five most vital workers (engineers, doctors).
choices.outcome_text: The workers recover and the shelter keeps running, but the others perish.
choices.epitaph: Calculated survival by the numbers.

choices.label: Lock the infected in a quarantined block and save the medicine for future elites.
choices.outcome_text: You listen to them cough to death through the steel door. The medicine remains stockpiled.
choices.epitaph: Hoarded salvation for a brighter day.

choices.label: Vent toxic gas into the quarantine block to 'cleanse' the infection instantly.
choices.outcome_text: The sickness is eradicated in minutes. The screams were brief.
choices.epitaph: Cured the disease by killing the host.

quests.trigger: Winter sets in early, and the food silos are shockingly low.
quests.discovery: A group of elderly survivors volunteers to leave the shelter to save rations for the children.

choices.label: Refuse their sacrifice. We all eat half-rations and survive together.
choices.outcome_text: Hunger gnaws at everyone, but nobody is left out in the cold.
choices.epitaph: Believed no one was expendable.

choices.label: Accept their offer with heavy heart, giving them a solemn farewell ceremony.
choices.outcome_text: They march into the snow with dignity. The children will eat this winter.
choices.epitaph: Honored the ultimate sacrifice.

choices.label: Force out anyone who can't work, regardless of whether they volunteered.
choices.outcome_text: Guards drag the weak and disabled into the blizzard. The remaining workers are terrified into submission.
choices.epitaph: Trimmed the fat with a rusty cleaver.

choices.label: Accept their offer, but execute them inside to harvest their meat for the silos.
choices.outcome_text: The 'mystery stew' keeps the children fed. Only you know the true cost.
choices.epitaph: Crossed a line that could never be uncrossed.

quests.trigger: The generator core is failing. A manual override is required in a lethally radioactive chamber.
quests.discovery: Someone must go in and press the button. They will not come out alive.

choices.label: Suit up and do it yourself. A true leader leads from the front.
choices.outcome_text: You secure the core. As the radiation claims you, you know the shelter will live on.
choices.epitaph: Gave everything for the people.

choices.label: Ask for a brave volunteer and promise to look after their family forever.
choices.outcome_text: A young engineer steps forward. The core is saved, and you bear the weight of their sacrifice.
choices.epitaph: Inspiring loyalty even unto death.

choices.label: Order a dissident prisoner to do it at gunpoint.
choices.outcome_text: The prisoner hits the switch before dissolving into ash. A convenient solution.
choices.epitaph: Used human lives as disposable tools.

choices.label: Trick a trusting child into climbing inside to 'fix a shiny toy'.
choices.outcome_text: The core whirs back to life. The child's final cries are drowned out by the machinery.
choices.epitaph: Traded innocent blood for electricity.

quests.trigger: You catch a strange frequency on the ham radio.
quests.discovery: A faint, trembling voice is reciting old poetry, intercut with coordinates to a pre-war bunker.

choices.label: Broadcast a comforting response, promising you are listening.
choices.outcome_text: The voice breaks into a sob of relief. You gain a friend in the dark.
choices.epitaph: Provided a beacon in a sea of static.

choices.label: Write down the coordinates and stay silent so they don't know you're coming.
choices.outcome_text: You have the location of the bunker, and the element of surprise.
choices.epitaph: Listened only for the tactical advantage.

choices.label: Jam the frequency. No time for ghost stories distracting the comms team.
choices.outcome_text: The channel goes dead. The comms room is quieter, but bleaker.
choices.epitaph: Silenced the past to survive the present.

choices.label: Broadcast back fake coordinates to lure them into a feral ghoul den.
choices.outcome_text: You hear their screams over the radio hours later. Good entertainment.
choices.epitaph: Used someone's desperate hope as a weapon.

quests.trigger: A wanderer collapses at the shelter gates, coughing up black blood.
quests.discovery: In their final moments, they grab your collar and whisper a secret about a flaw in your shelter's air filtration.

choices.label: Hold their hand and listen deeply, thanking them before they pass.
choices.outcome_text: They die in peace. You fix the filter, saving everyone from impending suffocation.
choices.epitaph: Found salvation in the words of the dying.

choices.label: Jot down the mechanical details, ignoring their emotional rambling.
choices.outcome_text: The engineering intel is solid. The filter is fixed, though the wanderer dies alone.
choices.epitaph: Extracted the data and discarded the soul.

choices.label: Strip their gear before they are fully dead, dismissing their whispers as delirium.
choices.outcome_text: You get some decent boots, but weeks later, the air starts tasting metallic.
choices.epitaph: Deaf to the warnings that mattered most.

choices.label: Kick them to make them spit out the rest of the secret faster, accelerating their death.
choices.outcome_text: They choke and die in agony. The secret dies with them.
choices.epitaph: Crushed the final spark of life out of impatience.

quests.display_name: Out of the Mouths of Babes
quests.trigger: A child in the shelter tugs on your sleeve while you're reviewing patrol maps.
quests.discovery: They tell you, matter-of-factly, that the 'scary men in gas masks' aren't monsters—they're just hungry and scared like us.

choices.label: Sit with the child. Realize they are right, and order your patrols to capture, not kill.
choices.outcome_text: You change the rules of engagement. Enemies become prisoners, then allies.
choices.epitaph: Let a child's innocence rewrite the laws of war.

choices.label: Pat the child's head and tell them grown-up things are complicated. Keep current orders.
choices.outcome_text: The war continues as usual. Innocence remains intact, but ignored.
choices.epitaph: Listened, but did not hear.

choices.label: Scold the child for sympathizing with the enemy and assign them double chores.
choices.outcome_text: The child cries and learns to stop talking. The shelter grows colder.
choices.epitaph: Stamped out compassion before it could bloom.

choices.label: Use the child's trusting nature to lure the masked men into a kill box.
choices.outcome_text: The men approach the child in peace, only to be mowed down by your snipers. The child is forever traumatized.
choices.epitaph: Weaponized innocence for absolute slaughter.
